goal: 对齐 Session 事件投影、持久化与官方回放
acceptance: Specify source-backed contract and required provider revisions before entering ready.
open_findings: Cold/live/prepared/storage/projection, bounded cache/point/corpus/title reads and lineage/event windows have clean 5c0b3c5e evidence. They do not certify the complete Session domain.

Full FTS ranking/cursors/reconciliation/index generations, all domain and plugin event types, Unicode locale/extraction, provider epochs/arbitrary Task cancellation, compressed JSONL and cross-process/multi-cwd recovery remain unaccepted.
Native upstream SQLite physical schema equivalence, long-history scale, complete current Web/profile/reconnect journeys and deferred Win7 remain separate unaccepted scopes.
next_action: 以 5c0b3c5e 已签收的缓存、point/corpus/title 与 tracing 为基础，先补业务过滤，再完整 FTS/增量索引/代际、域/事件类型与长期恢复；随后完成 Web/profile 主链。父范围仍 draft，无全范围验收。
